# Psalm 25 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 25:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Of-David. To-You, YHWH, my-soul I-lift-up.
- **LOGOS:** Of David. To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul.
- **PNEUMA:** A psalm of David. LORD, I give my life to You.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 25:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** My-God, in-You I-trust; let-me-not be-put-to-shame; let-not my-enemies exult over-me.
- **LOGOS:** O my God, in You I trust; let me not be put to shame; let not my enemies exult over me.
- **PNEUMA:** I trust in You, my God! Do not let me be disgraced, or let my enemies rejoice in my defeat.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 25:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **PNEUMA:** No one who trusts in You will ever be disgraced, but disgrace comes to those who try to deceive others.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **PNEUMA:** He leads the humble in doing right, teaching them His way.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
